scenario: `after` timer fires after the clock advances past the delay per LTAC.3.1. Assert a Trig and advance the clock past 5_s: the follow-up rule fires and its plain emit leaves a ttl Delayed fact, so two facts live. The body emits a ttl fact rather than a logical one because a logical emit in an after body is refused (LLOG.11.9) — its justifying activation ends inside its own firing when the follow-up retracts the timer (LTAC.3.4).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

schema Delayed scope ttl 1_h:
    dummy: Int

rule delayed:
    Trig
->
    log info "trig"
    after 5_s:
        emit Delayed dummy: 0
